benchmark: fc2_eb_ring (fidelity class 2: EB ring movable persistent bump)
band_verbatim: (C1) after a transient wedge seed, a LOCALIZED bump (circular variance <= 0.6 over EPG positive activity) PERSISTS >= 2 simulated seconds in darkness with retention >= 0.05 of post-seed activity, AND the settled bump POSITION follows the seed (>= 4 distinguishable positions across seeds at 4 preregistered angles -- this is the anti-fixed-point criterion class 1 failed); (C2) asymmetric PEN drive rotates the bump with OPPOSITE signs for left vs right drive, |rate| >= 0.05 deg/step-equivalent.

class1_reference.result: C1 position-following 0/21 (fixed-point attractor near 222 deg everywhere alive); measured 2026-09-29, results/benchmarks/cx_ring.json
citations: Kim et al. 2017 Science 356:849 (WTA is correct physiology)
